rows.strengths: Authentic Indian banking names (HDFC, ICICI, SBI) with realistic ₹ Cr revenue figures; data structure is clean and tidy as session preaches.
rows.weaknesses: Fundamentally misses the session's pedagogy—session teaches PivotTable GUI mechanics (drag zones, grouping, slicers, drill-down), but sim forces formula-replication of pivot logic, which is Session 3.3/3.6 territory, not 3.9.
rows.fix_directive: Rewrite as a true pivot exercise: provide pre-built data, ask students to create actual PivotTable with specific field placements (Rows/Columns/Values/Filters), apply grouping to quarters, insert slicer, sort by revenue, compute % of grand total—test the four-zone drag model and GUI features the session explicitly teaches.
